scope: DWG-derived SAT v1 DXF continuations and native-focused regression follow-up

authority.document: Spatial SAT Format 7.0, save-file example and counted-string descriptions
authority.observation: The SAT 4.0 example uses bare decimal lengths for product strings containing spaces. The local SAB-to-SAT serializer also produces bare counted strings for its selected non-700 carrier.

peerObservation.producer: ODA File Converter 27.10.0.0 Linux x64, offline container; DXF R2000 to DWG R2000 and back
peerObservation.input: Scratch-only public SAT 4.0 documentation example; the long control changes the first counted product string to 220 ASCII bytes. Both byte-cut and token-boundary-cut DXFs have the same SAT bytes.
peerObservation.result: The unmodified short header survives in three SAT lines. For the long header, ODA's re-export turns a product continuation into a separate group 1 and joins its remainder to the following tolerance line in both split variants. Thus token boundaries alone do not establish product-header preservation for this peer.
peerObservation.limits: ezdxf's ACIS parser did not interpret this SAT 4.0 sample's numeric coedge booleans, so this is header framing evidence, not a geometry or native AutoCAD acceptance claim. External derivatives remain scratch-only.

implementation: Protect possible bare decimal counted-string spans as well as explicit @ spans when choosing continuation boundaries. Overlapping possible spans are conservatively combined; unrepresentable spans are refused.
For recognized SAT version 200+ headers, refuse a product-information line that would need multiple encoded DXF values; retain single-value headers and version 106 body continuation.
Replace the prior generated round-trip control's unbroken oversized fake token with bounded tokens while preserving multi-chunk, caret escape, ASCII/Binary and public readback checks.
validation: PASS: macOS ARM64 focused full libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip, transaction and SAT token controls; the formerly failing native-focused executable passes.
PASS: focused bare and @ counted-string boundary, exact reconstruction, embedded apparent marker, product-header refusal, SAT 106 body and caret tests.

PASS: product-header refusal preserves a preexisting destination and a corrected retry succeeds in ASCII and Binary output; an additional actual-writer scratch probe preserved a sentinel for the long 4.0 sample.
PASS: GCC 13.3 Linux ARM64 compiles src/libdxfrw.cpp with -O1 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror.
limitations: Potential bare counts can conservatively overlap ordinary numeric tokens and cause refusal for a representable long line; no universal SAT grammar, native AutoCAD behavior, other peer releases, or broad 3D support is claimed.

hostedRegression.jobs: Linux GCC, macOS Clang and Windows MSVC focused
hostedRegression.observed: Each failed the generated oversized-token AC1015 SAT export control; local replacement control passes the full focused executable. Hosted validation of this correction remains pending.
